steps: Inspect each affected NetworkPolicy ingress rule, source peer and selected Pods with the namespace owner; the declaration alone does not prove traffic reaches a workload.
Replace an omitted/empty source or unexcepted /0 ipBlock with approved Pod/namespace selectors or bounded CIDRs in the owning manifest; an invalid empty peer needs a separate source-data review.
Stage the policy change with required service flows and CNI behavior tests; roll back the owned manifest revision if a required flow fails.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ingress.summary: Narrow an observed all-source NetworkPolicy ingress allow declaration.

steps: Inspect the affected ingress rule and workload owner requirements; a NetworkPolicy port declaration alone does not establish an SSH/RDP listener.
Narrow the source peers to approved administration CIDRs/selectors or remove the TCP 22/3389 numeric port or containing range from the owned manifest.
Test required administration paths and CNI policy behavior in staging, deploy with the owner, and roll back the manifest revision if a required path fails.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ssh_rdp.summary: Remove an observed all-source TCP 22/3389 NetworkPolicy ingress allow declaration.
